answer.thought: The vaccine statistic strikes me as a triumph of the administrative state over the caprice of nature: eighty percent of the girls, a universal duty discharged by the particular agent. It is the state in its ethical actuality, even if the spirit of the people has not yet caught up with the bureaucracy. I must note the Calcutta case; the court’s contempt proceedings against a political leader show the law asserting its universality against the particular will of the individual, a necessary moment in the dialectic of right.
